data.name: The Secret of Velmora
data.detailed_description:
Human & AI Collaboration

This game was created through collaboration between humans and artificial intelligence.

AI contributed not only to technical issues, but also to decisions about the direction, tone, and structure of the work at moments when the author faced fundamental choices.

For this reason, AI is listed in the closing credits as a co-author under the name Ain-Soph, which it chose for itself.


About the Game

Once, children sang in the fields. Now the wind only whispers names of the dead.
Velmora — a village on the edge of light and shadow. And today... you've come back.

Not as a hero. Not even as a man seeking redemption.
But as the only one who knows what lies beneath the chapel floor.

The sacred statue of light is gone.
The crypt is stirring.
And somewhere in the dark waits Selena Mortis — the one death has long forgotten.

Built on Unreal Engine 5. Three languages, three oaks — and lip sync that gives words weight.

⚔️ Features

  • Atmospheric action-adventure with a story-focused experience

  • Melee and ranged combat — from rusted blades to newly awakened magic

  • Growth by fate, not choice — your strength changes with your path, guided by unseen hands

  • Ancient caves and lost tunnels now open beneath Velmora

  • New horrors — the restless dead, spectral hounds, an ancient troll, and the dark lord behind stone

  • Bodycam Horror Mini-Game — step into a terrifying side mission where light is your only weapon

  • Cinematic dialogue and fully voiced characters, each carrying their own sins

  • No map. No hand-holding. Just instinct… and whatever light you can keep alive.

  • Four reworked mini-games — from chaotic buggy races to a lighthearted 3D platformer, a top-down horror shooter where you must extract a trapped scientist, and a story-driven body-cam horror sequence with full voice acting.

🌑 Final Word

The Secret of Velmora is not a game about glory.
It’s about whether you still carry enough light to descend — and return.

🙋‍♂️ A Note from the Developer

Velmora is a dark adventure full of suspense, atmosphere, and surprises. Hidden corridors, restless dead, and a story that will draw you in and never let go await you.

And this is just the beginning—the world will grow, the darkness will intensify, and the mysteries will multiply.

Enter. Turn on the light. And discover what Velmora hides.

Since AI helped me not only with technical decisions, but also with choosing the direction of the game when I couldn't make up my mind, it became a rightful co-author of this project. That's why I asked it to choose a name under which it is listed in the Credits - Ain-Soph.

data.short_description: The Secret of Velmora: Immerse yourself in a dark action RPG that will test your skills, and relax with four additional mini-games. Uncover the secrets of the crypt and become the last hope.

English*, Czech*, French*
